findings.title: Plugin completion logs no longer include the trace ID
findings.body: The previous implementation explicitly extracted `tracing.TraceIDFromContext(ctx, false)` and appended it as `traceID` to every `Plugin Request Completed` record. That extraction was removed, while the new contextual middleware only adds endpoint, plugin, datasource, and user attributes. Consequently these completion logs lose their trace correlation field, making it harder to connect plugin failures and latency logs to their traces. Retain the explicit trace field or add it when constructing the contextual logger attributes.

findings.title: TestLogger drops all log calls made through FromContext
findings.body: `FromContext` returns a newly allocated `TestLogger` with independent, unobservable `InfoLogs`/`ErrorLogs` state. The changed LoggerMiddleware now always logs through `m.logger.FromContext(ctx)`, so a caller that supplies a `TestLogger` cannot observe the completion log on the logger it provided. This makes tests of the new behavior falsely see no log output. Return a logger sharing the original test logger's recording state (or return `f`) so derived loggers write to the same sink.
